targets.approach: From the Fairy Meadow hut, follow the path toward Friendship Col and the Echo Glacier. Gog is the higher, closer-to-the-col summit of the Gog-Magog pair, and the route starts on its east face, reached by hiking across the snow below it and crossing the moat to the rock.
targets.descent_text: Rappel back down the east face to the base. Cross the moat and walk down the snowfield toward the Friendship Col trail and the hut.
targets.name: Gog East Face

targets.approach: From the Fairy Meadow hut, hike as if going to Friendship Col, then branch right toward the ridge. The line begins on the lowest reaches of the Shoestring Glacier, almost opposite Quadrant's south face, and gains the northern end of Sentinel's north ridge.
targets.name: Sentenel Peak - Shoofly Arete of North Ridge

targets.approach: Park at the BC Hydro campground at Seton Lake, cross the aqueduct and walk to the base of the wall. The route is on the left-hand side of the face.
targets.name: The Further Adventures of Trogdor the Burninator

targets.approach: Follow the Sky Pilot approach to the Stadium Glacier and traverse west toward Copilot. Seppuku is on the north side of the peak, to the right of the main chimney that splits the face on the viewer's left; the first pitch climbs a right-arcing crack and slot that begins with a small roof.
targets.descent_text: Rappel the NE route from bolted anchors.
targets.name: Seppuku

targets.approach: Follow the normal Sky Pilot approach up to the Stadium Glacier, then cross easy snow slopes west to the foot of Copilot. Leave the snow and scramble up to the start of a corner, which is where the climbing begins; the scree can be extensive late in summer.
targets.name: West Ridge

targets.approach: The trailhead is at the head of Powell Lake and needs a boat transfer. From there bike up the Daniels valley beside the Daniels River, then bushwhack up to the subalpine on the east ridge. Cross a few bumps to a final bump on the ridge, which is descended on its left side by slippery fourth class, and the east face is then in view; campsites lie on the way to the base of the steep rock.
targets.descent_text: Downclimb or rappel the route ledge to ledge in short rappels.
targets.name: Mt Denman East face

targets.approach: Take the established Hermit trail up until the cliff shows through the thinning timber, then contour west through several bushy gullies to a level bench on the Grizzly avalanche path. Cross the bench low to the boulder field, ford the creek, and climb to the left side of the small waterfalls above. From the foot of the falls traverse up and left along cairns to the upper boulder field, then cross it to the cliff base. The route is the clean, continuous crack system running up the centre of the face, with a large anchored ledge a short way up that can be reached from the left when snow lingers at the base.
targets.name: Pooh Crack

targets.descent_text: From the top, scramble south or southeast to a rappel station; one rope gets you down onto the south ridge. Scramble from there to the col between South Spire and Rexford, then descend the steep sandy gully, class 2 to 3 or snow-filled early in the season, to the basin.
targets.name: South Spire - North Ridge (AD-)
